B so 引出 preparation period...long 的解释，按书中赛事叙述理解。
C 前句强调可能失牌，非无害。
D 未将四年与个人开训年龄相连，不添具体赛程日期。

vocabulary.context: 添加赛期间隔造成长期准备这一层理由，与前句小失误风险相加。
vocabulary.example: The plan is expensive. Moreover, it requires more time.

questions.evidenceQuote: A tiny mistake could cost you a medal. Moreover, the Olympic Games take place every four years, so the preparation period is extremely long. A moment can rob you of your dream and a decade of dedication. Despite achieving spectacular success, both Michael Phelps and Simone Biles suffered from anxiety and depression.

questions.prompt: How does the contrast between 'a moment' and 'a decade' support the argument?
questions.promptZh: a moment 与 a decade 的对比怎样服务论证？
options: It says every decade contains only a single moment.
It proves the athletes spent exactly ten years on each event.
It highlights how a brief failure can jeopardise years of dedication and a dream.
It says past effort is literally removed from a person's history.
optionsZh: 说每个十年仅有一个瞬间。
证明运动员每项比赛恰好练十年。
突出短暂失误可能危及多年投入与梦想。
说过去努力被字面上从人生历史删除。
analyses: A 不是时间单位的字面定义。
B decade 的修辞性反差不提供每人精确训练年表。
C 短与长对比加强高压环境的得失重大。
D rob 为失去成果机会的比喻，不能把历史经历视为真的被抹除，也不诊断运动员此刻状况。

vocabulary.context: 在此比喻瞬间失误危及梦想与长期投入的成果，不是具体抢劫事件。
vocabulary.example: A sudden cancellation robbed them of the chance to perform.

questions.evidenceQuote: A tiny mistake could cost you a medal. Moreover, the Olympic Games take place every four years, so the preparation period is extremely long. A moment can rob you of your dream and a decade of dedication. Despite achieving spectacular success, both Michael Phelps and Simone Biles suffered from anxiety and depression.

questions.prompt: What distinction is made by saying the athletes lost interest in sports 'in which they excelled'?
questions.promptZh: 说运动员对自己擅长的项目失去兴趣，区分了什么？
options: High achievement and continued interest need not always coincide.
They had never been skilled in those sports.
Every athlete must lose interest after winning.
Loss of interest proves that all previous medals were invalid.
optionsZh: 高成就与持续兴趣未必总重合。
他们从未擅长这些项目。
每位运动员获胜后都必失兴趣。
失去兴趣证明此前奖牌全无效。
analyses: A 对擅长项目仍可失去兴趣，有限说明技能成就与感受不总一致。
B excelled 明确过去擅长。
C 两人叙述不能推每位运动员必然如此。
D 兴趣变化不能推奖牌资格无效；不由此虚构当下心理状况。

vocabulary.context: 说明项目中的成就，不保证每时每刻都享受。
vocabulary.example: She excelled in the subject but later explored other interests.

questions.evidenceQuote: They lost interest in the sports in which they excelled. Single-minded dedication is surely admirable, even virtuous. But, too much single-mindedness could rob you of the simple joy of just being able to jump, run, or swim.

questions.prompt: Why acknowledge that single-minded dedication is admirable before saying 'But'?
questions.promptZh: But 之前为何承认专心投入值得钦佩？
options: To withdraw every criticism of excessive focus.
To establish that all training is harmful.
To claim playfulness and effort can never coexist.
To recognise dedication's value before warning about too much single-mindedness.
optionsZh: 撤回对过度专注的所有批评。
认定所有训练都有害。
宣称玩心与努力绝不相容。
先承认投入价值，再提醒过度专注的代价。
analyses: A But 后仍保留过度专注的警惕。
B admirable 不是反对全部训练。
C 未给相互排斥的必然规则。
D 让步式平衡区分 dedication 与 too much single-mindedness，could 仍为可能失去简单快乐。

vocabulary.context: 正面评价投入本身，与随后警惕过度可以同时成立。
vocabulary.example: Her patience in completing the difficult task was admirable.

questions.prompt: What does 'is the name of the game' mean in the elite-athlete passage?
questions.promptZh: 精英运动员段落中 is the name of the game 是什么意思？
options: It supplies the official title of a new sport.
It identifies repeated practice as the dominant requirement or priority.
It says all competition can be replaced by a naming game.
It guarantees medals to anyone who practises once.
optionsZh: 给一项新运动正式命名。
指出反复训练是占主导的要求或重点。
说所有竞赛可由起名游戏替代。
保证练一次就赢奖牌。
analyses: A 不是赛事正式名称。
B idiom 表在这个领域最重要的事，重复 practice 加强。
C 非字面游戏替代竞赛。
D 反复训练不是一次，也非保证结果；Yet 后转向玩耍的发展价值。

vocabulary.meaning: 关键；某领域最重要的事
vocabulary.context: 习语，不是给游戏起名字；此处表精英训练文化中的优先项。
vocabulary.example: For this project, careful observation is the name of the game.

questions.evidenceQuote: In the world of elite athletes, practice, practice, and more practice is the name of the game. There is not much space for playfulness. Yet play and playfulness are critical for healthy child development. Alison Gopnik argues that humans have an extraordinarily long childhood, during which they can try out many things before they are forced to specialize in one area as adults.

questions.prompt: What sequence does Gopnik's account of childhood emphasise?
questions.promptZh: Gopnik 关于童年的说法强调什么顺序？
options: Specialisation must precede every opportunity to explore.
Adults never specialise in any area.
A long period of trying many things comes before adult specialisation.
All children must specialise in the same sport at eight.
optionsZh: 专攻必须早于一切探索机会。
成年人从不专攻任何领域。
先有较长尝试多事物的时期，再成年专门化。
所有孩子必须八岁专攻同种运动。
analyses: A 把 before 关系反转。
B 原句说成年时专门化。
C during childhood...try many things before...as adults 保留序列和 Gopnik 观点归属。
D 没统一运动或年龄要求；这是所引解释，不把人物故事变成对所有孩子的训练处方。

vocabulary.context: 与童年较广探索对照，不是说成人不能再有其他兴趣。
vocabulary.example: She decided to specialize in one area after exploring several subjects.
